description: Feather is modern, intuitive, convention based, mobile-first UI for Telerik Sitefinity™. This NuGet package has dependencies to the core NuGet packages that are related to the Telerik Sitefinity™. Note that this NuGet package can be installed on projects of any kind. However, this NuGet package is mostly applicable for the development of standalone components (i.e. componenets that are packed in separate assemblies).
title: Telerik.Sitefinity.Feather.StandAlone
